title: Linear descent of the explicit Koszul product-fibre construction
statement:
Let $\mathcal S$ be a small site [def-weil-size-convention], $\mathcal O$ a sheaf of commutative rings, and $A$ a commutative ring acting on $\mathcal O$ through global sections. Assume countable products of $\mathcal O$-module sheaves are exact. Fix a finite list $b_1,\ldots,b_r\in\Gamma(\mathcal S,\mathcal O)$, allowing $r=0$. Use cochain complexes and their unbounded derived category [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Set $Q_m=\bigotimes_{j=1}^r[\mathcal O\xrightarrow{b_j^m}\mathcal O]$, in degrees $[-r,0]$, with the transition multiplication by $b_j$ in degree $-1$ and identity in degree $0$ in each factor [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. For a cochain complex $M$, set $B(M)=\prod_{m\geq1}(M\otimes Q_m)$, let $s$ use the quotient-tower transitions, and put
$$F(M)^i=B(M)^i\oplus B(M)^{i-1},\qquad d(x,y)=(d_Bx,(1-s)x-d_By).$$
For a chain map $a:M\to N$, use the product of $a\otimes1$ in both summands to define $F(a)$. This assignment preserves chain homotopies and quasi-isomorphisms and induces an additive $A$-linear functor $C:D(\mathcal O)\to D(\mathcal O)$ [def-weil-linear-functor]. It represents $R\lim_m(M\otimes^L Q_m)$, with the natural coaugmentation $\kappa_M:M\to C(M)$ induced by the degree-zero inclusions $\mathcal O\to Q_m$. The canonical maps $F(0)\cong0$ and $F(M\oplus N)\cong F(M)\oplus F(N)$ identify these coaugmentations and are natural. In particular, the full subcategory on objects for which $\kappa_M$ is invertible is additive, with the inherited $A$-linear Hom modules, and $C(ta)=tC(a)$ for $t\in A$.
